title: Cultivation Pill Affinity
text:
When refining a cultivation pill, the highest non-neutral elemental score determines its affinity.


If several elements tie for the highest score, each has an equal chance of becoming the pill's affinity.


This applies to both cultivation-progress and Qi-absorption pills. Their affinity must be compatible with your cultivation.


T1 versions are for Foundation Establishment, T2 for Qi Condensation, and T3 for Core Formation. A pill from another realm cannot be used for cultivation.


These two effects share the cultivation-family cooldown, so switching between them does not bypass it.
